headline: Fed Officials Sound Dovish, Dollar Eases; New Taiwan Dollar Surges to 31.6 - Finance
summary: Federal Reserve officials sounded dovish, US stocks closed broadly higher and Treasury yields fell. The dollar index dropped below 99 and the New Taiwan dollar strengthened to the 31.6 level.
why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence global dollar liquidity, Treasury yields and capital flows into emerging Asian markets.

impacts.name: New Taiwan dollar
impacts.why: Dovish Fed remarks weakened the US dollar, lifting the New Taiwan dollar against it.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Federal Reserve officials' dovish remarks pushed US Treasury yields lower and the dollar index down, while US stocks closed higher. Major Asian currencies rose in response.
